pwsbuilder June 30, 2018

Visit the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists on Saturday, July 14 for a free demonstration of how to paint trees with watercolor on yupo paper, a plastic medium that allows the paint to slide on the surface and produce sometimes surprising results!  Anne Briggs will lead the demonstration from 2 to 4 PM at the gallery located at 551 Main St. (Rte. 28) in Harwich Port.

The Art Gallery (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) in Harwich Port, (508) 432-1012. Free parking across the street at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Visitors Information Center.
